queries.label: AI モデル/製品 launch
queries.prompt:
Use x_search to find the top 3 most-liked X posts in the past 48 hours about new AI model launches or product releases from Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Meta AI, Mistral, or Cohere.

Output in Japanese (日本語で出力必須). Format strictly:

1. 【見出し】1〜2 文の日本語要約
URL: https://x.com/...
投稿者: @handle (❤️N)

2. 【見出し】...

3. 【見出し】...

No English explanations. No preamble. Just the 3 numbered items in Japanese.
